sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 567 (all pages via campsitePaging.do, 119 campsites + 1 group camp parsed)

values.note: Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' DEC's 2026 campground summary. ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/ausable-point-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=567 (Booking Window 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 nights. From July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights'; CHECK-IN TIME 'by 9:00 p.m. on the first night') + DEC 2026 campground summary (Ausable Point RES MIN 2), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/ausable-point-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=567 (Season Schedule 2027: Core 'Fri May 14 2027', Non Peak ends 'Sun Oct 10 2027'; DEC's 2026 summary gives May 15 - Oct 12 for 2026), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DEC lists 123 sites; ReserveAmerica sells 119 campsites and a group camp in four loops, all back-in, nearly all 30-35 ft (95 at 35 ft, 13 at 30, 4 at 40, 5 at 20).

sites.source: https://dec.ny.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/summerreccampgroundsummary.pdf ('Ausable Point 518-561-7080 123') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 567 ('35 Back-In' 95, '30 Back-In' 13, '20 Back-In' 5, '40 Back-In' 4, 'Back-In' 3), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 567 (all 119 campsites 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/ausable-point-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=567 ('restrooms with showers, a trailer dump station'; Services and Amenities 'Water Fillup Station', 'Water Spigot'), read 2026-10-21

note: DEC campground on a point in Lake Champlain (Peru), with a natural sand shoreline and a view of Valcour Island; borders a wildlife management area. Prone to flooding in spring, which can move a reservation to another site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $22 + $5 non-resident, phone 518-561-7080, 2-night pre-season reservation minimum (DEC 2026 summary), ReserveAmerica 9-month window (now on the entry) and 14-night max, no electric (now from the RA site list). Added 2027 season May 14 - Oct 10, 123 sites to 40 ft (all back-in), showers, dump, water fill. Note trimmed of hookups/booking/season/rating/minimum-stay text; kept the spring-flooding caveat from RA.
